invariants.name: monotonicity
invariants.description: When more tickets are allowed to be sold, the maximum achievable contribution does not decrease. This guarantees that the first index i where the maximum contribution reaches k is the minimum answer.

invariants.name: descending_weight_optimal_assignment
invariants.description: For any number of sold tickets, the maximum total contribution is obtained by matching the largest ticket prices to the positions with the highest contribution percentages: first positions that are multiples of both a and b (weight x+y), then positions that are multiples of only the larger-percentage interval (weight x), then positions that are multiples of only the smaller-percentage interval (weight y).
